sonuclar.tahmin_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers;

SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    month;

SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
    t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 
    2
  ) AS late_delivery_percentage
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month';
SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products;
SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items;

SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS score_count
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY review_score
ORDER BY review_score;

SELECT payment_installments, COUNT(*) AS installment_count
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card' AND payment_installments IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY payment_installments
ORDER BY installment_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT customers.customer_city, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
GROUP BY customers.customer_city
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT sellers.seller_id, SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN sellers ON order_items.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
GROUP BY sellers.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS ciro
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE 
    o.order_purchase_timestamp BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31'
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    ay;

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp))) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    avg_delivery_time DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders)) AS orans
FROM 
  (SELECT customer_id
   FROM orders
   GROUP BY customer_id
   HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS cte;

SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_payments
JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1;
